title: Minyamin, an Egyptian convert
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Mentioned in Yevamot 76b: Rabbi Yehudah said, “Minyamin, an Egyptian convert, was a fellow student of mine among Rabbi Akiva’s disciples.” Hyman cites chapter 5 of the Tosefta, where Rabbi Akiva tells him, “Binyamin, you have erred.” Hyman identifies him as Minyamin.

notes.text: Hyman identifies the Binyamin of the Tosefta with Minyamin. The notice does not authorize a canonical identity merge.
The response is found in Tosefta Kiddushin 5:6 and in Lieberman’s edition at 5:4. Both give Binyamin in Akiva’s address. Yevamot 76b has Minyamin.
